title: Chaos
description: A fast-paced PvP mode where random disasters and constantly changing gear keep every match unpredictable. Be the last man standing to win!
body:
Chaos is a fast-paced PvP survival minigame where everything is unpredictable. Players are thrown into an arena and must fight to be the last one standing while the game unleashes random disasters and ever-changing gear.

It supports any amount of players. More players = more fun!

Download the world file [here](https://github.com/Shaheer-Afaq/chaos/releases/download/minecraft_minigame/chaos.world.zip)
